title: Your personal changes
empty: Your course has no personal changes yet.
intro: Changes your supervisor made for you, and why. Hiding an optional addition removes it from your lessons without affecting any checks or evidence; you can restore it at any time. Undoing a change removes it for good; your answers and progress stay.
kind.insert_episode: Added a short lesson for you
unverified.label: Unverified.
unverified.body: Written by AI and checked automatically; no person has reviewed it.
transfer: Your next independent check on this: {statuses}.
reverted: Undone. It no longer appears in your lessons.
revertedOn: Undone on {date}. It no longer appears in your lessons.
saveFailed: That change could not be saved. Nothing changed.
required: Required for your path. Ask your companion or course team if you disagree.
undo.question: Undo this change? Your answers and progress stay.
undo.failed: That change could not be undone. Nothing changed.
undo.label: Undo: {label}
checked: Checked automatically before it was added: {checks}.
check.host_model_agreement: the simulation's picture, formula and table agree
check.host_answer_key: the answer comes from the course's own model
check.host_code_reference: a correct solution passes the hidden tests and wrong ones fail
check.host_component_tests: the model passes its own tests
addedAfterAttempt: It waited until you had finished the question you were working on, and you added it.
why.fresh_question: You asked for a fresh question. It was checked before it was added, and it tests the same skill as the course's own question.
why.staff_remedial_episode: Course staff added a lesson the course author wrote and reviewed for this situation.
why.supervisor_remedial_episode: After you agreed, a lesson the course author wrote and reviewed was added.
why.supervisor_reviewed_explanation: After you agreed, an explanation the course author wrote and reviewed was added.
why.supervisor_generated_teaching: After you agreed, new teaching was written for you. The course's own checks verified its content before it was added.
